description: This file defines the LocationSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and encapsulates filter parameters for location searches, including fields like name, city, and country code. It also specifies allowed sort fields relevant to location data.

classes.name: LocationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters on locations, including sorting and filtering by name, city, and country code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'location.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'city' filter.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'countryCode' filter.
